design.source: selection-lab caches (patched daily rate-hedged excess returns); monthly decisions from 2022-01-03 to 2026-09-01; tranches held H bdays from entry (first trade after decision, <=20 bdays); book = average of live tranches; issuer cap 10%; bond cost 25 bps (50 check) per round trip on book turnover

buckets.D10: top decile of eligible universe by cdi_bps (CDI+ equivalent), point-in-time

filters.P4f: not rich vs peers (resid_z > -1.5) and no press_neg_30d
filters.Q: drop worst quintile composite quality (uncovered kept)

equity_hedge.reg: short issuer/parent stock, ratio = 0.5*own + 0.5*pooled HY median of trailing 252d weekly Dimson beta (lag 0+1) of bond hedged returns on stock excess returns, clipped [0,1]
equity_hedge.struct: ratio = 1.0 * duration * spread (Merton-style, dln spread/dln E = -1), cap 0.5
equity_hedge.top: reg ratio, only positions flagged at decision: top 5% carry OR worst-quintile quality OR stock <= -15% in 4w
equity_hedge.trig: reg ratio, switched on (for the rest of the tranche) once the stock's 21d return <= -15%
equity_hedge.jtd: jump-to-default sizing: ratio 0.5 on top-risk positions only (bond LGD ~50% vs stock -80..-100% in default)

design.macro_hedge: short Ibovespa futures (P&L = -beta * (Ibov - CDI)), beta = trailing 252d weekly Dimson beta of the cohort basket, clipped [0,1]; SMAL11 same with 2%/yr ETF borrow
design.put_proxy: APPROXIMATION: roll 3m 10%-OTM Ibovespa puts priced Black-Scholes at a fixed IV (22%, 27% skew check), premium financed at CDI, 10% of premium paid as spread; notional = book beta x exposure, or 25% of exposure
design.recovery_sensitivity: bonds that stop trading >30d before data end and before maturity with last mark < 0.90 (55 bonds) jump to 40% of par on their last grid day
